def residues (p q : Nat) : List Nat := (List.range q).map (fun i => (p * (i + 1)) % q)

def check_rational_residues : Bool :=
  residues 1 2 == [1, 0] &&
  residues 1 3 == [1, 2, 0] &&
  residues 2 3 == [2, 1, 0] &&
  residues 1 4 == [1, 2, 3, 0] &&
  residues 3 4 == [3, 2, 1, 0]
